title: Chapter 19: First Battle Lost (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 19: First Battle Lost (Part 2)

Using hydralisks for close combat, especially when the gap between the enemy and us is so obvious, Wu Qing obviously would not do such a stupid thing.

400 puppies hiding underground suddenly came out at the most appropriate time, instantly interrupting the charge of the bear goblin soldiers.

They also split the formation of the bear goblin charging soldiers into several pieces.

This sudden change also shocked the priests and commanders of the bear goblins.

Enemies that can lurk underground so secretly are very scary without effective detection methods.

You don’t know how many enemy troops are lurking underground.

The priest frowned, stood on the lizard mount, observed the surrounding terrain, and looked at the sudden change in the battlefield. He ordered: "Send four teams to reinforce!"

"Pay attention to this formation and be ready to fight at any time!"

"Yes! Lord Priest!"

Another knight took the order and left. He came to the front of the formation and led 400 bear goblin soldiers to quickly reinforce the front line.

At this time, the number of soldiers in the main camp of the bear goblin army was less than a thousand.

The battlefield situation fell into a state of anxiety again.

The number of bear goblin soldiers was still superior to that of the puppies. Some soldiers took advantage of the momentum of the previous charge and rushed to the front of the hydralisks and had a head-on melee with the hydralisks.

In reality, hydralisks can fight in close combat, but close combat is not their specialty. They are easily injured when encountering professional opponents.

At the cost of more than a dozen hydralisks being injured, the hydralisk phalanx successfully eliminated the enemies who rushed to the front.

The hydralisks' attacks have never stopped. Although in the case of a melee between the enemy and us, their killing effect is not good due to the influence of the rules of the real world, the overall killing effect on the enemy is still very considerable.

Their close cooperation with the puppies is the strong guarantee for the undefeated situation.

In the front battlefield, with the reinforcement of 400 bear goblin soldiers, no matter how crazy the puppies fight, they can't change the ending of being eliminated soon.

Just as the bugbear soldiers were vigilantly guarding against the Zerg reinforcements from underground, the 200 puppies that Wu Qing had recently assembled in the rear rushed out from behind the hydralisk phalanx again.

Ignoring the huge gap in the number of enemies and ourselves, they rushed forward desperately.

Without waiting for the underground reinforcements of the Zerg, the bugbear soldiers were about to rush to the hydralisk phalanx in one go to eliminate these annoying spitting insects, but were blocked by the 200 new puppies that came to reinforce.

They could only vent their anger on the puppies, continue to entangle with them, and enjoy the saliva attack greetings of the hydralisks.

"This mysterious enemy has endless means and is not easy to deal with!"

The bugbear priest also discovered new situations.

The Zerg's uninterrupted reserve forces and the close coordination of multiple arms made him feel threatened.

He now doubted the authenticity of the intelligence about this area. If the intelligence was unreliable, and the forces of the mysterious race on the opposite side exceeded the tolerance of his army, they would be in danger of being wiped out.

With the enemy's individual quality and fighting will, the outcome of the battlefield failure is self-evident.

"Master Priest, should we continue to reinforce?"

A knight stood up and asked respectfully.

The priest looked at the battlefield in front of him, pondered for a while, and his eyes suddenly became firm.

"Let's attack with all our forces!"

"I want to see how many tricks this race that came out of nowhere has!"

"Yes! Master Priest!"

Several more knights took the order and left.

"Woo...!"

The horn for the whole army to attack sounded!

"All the troops attack!"

"All the troops go out!"

"All the troops go out!"

The most elite soldiers of the main camp of the bear goblin army lined up in a neat formation and strode towards the battlefield.

Seeing this scene, Wu Qing couldn't help but praise: "This commander has a very keen sense of the battlefield. Now is indeed the best time for the whole army to attack."

"If you hesitate any longer, you will be the ones to be beaten next!"

"Now, I am the one who is uncomfortable."

"Alas, I have to lose the first battle when I meet my opponent."

In the Zerg territory, the number of mother nests has increased to 20. When the army continues to grow, 40 puppies can be hatched at a time.

The bloody battle on the front line is providing resource support for the territory's army.

The enemy is getting weaker and weaker, while the Zerg is not getting stronger and stronger, but at least the overall loss is not too great.

After the combat units in the front are finished, a new batch of units will come out from the back, one after another.

It may take more than ten or twenty years for other races to train a soldier, while it only takes one or two minutes for the Zerg to hatch a soldier.

This is an extremely huge advantage and the strongest reliance of the Zerg to defeat everything.

Now, the entire army of the bear goblins is pressing forward, and Wu Qing will transfer the 200 puppies that have been assembled long ago to the battlefield again.

Before the arrival of the Bugbear Army, the three phalanxes of the Hydralisk began to retreat in an orderly manner.

Another 200 puppies joined the battlefield, trying their best to block the advance of the Bugbear Army and escort the Hydralisk's calm retreat.

The Zerg were not slow, and the Hydralisk quickly retreated to the next preset battlefield.

The Hosts also evacuated, and they had been lingering at a certain distance from the battlefield, so that until now, the Bugbear Priest had not discovered the existence of the Hosts.

The Bugbear Army finally arrived at the battlefield, and then all the stubborn puppies were wiped out.

The battlefield, which was supposed to be bloody, became clean in an instant. All the corpses turned into light in front of the bear goblin army, leaving only weapons and equipment and sundries on the ground.

All the bear goblin soldiers looked at this scene with some awe, silently chanting the name of the god of faith in their hearts, and strengthening their own beliefs.

This is a world where gods appear in the world, and they need to be in awe of the means of such gods.

There is no need to clean up the battlefield, and the bear goblin army reorganized its formation.

After a simple statistics, there are less than 400 of the 1,200 bear goblin soldiers sent out, plus the 300 people lost by the vanguard, the total force has been lost by more than half.

This is an extremely tragic war of attrition!

A big battle consumed most of the troops, and the bear goblin priests were silent in the face of this situation.

The injured bear goblin soldiers were bandaging themselves to recover from their injuries. They have a strong physique, and as long as they are not seriously injured and disabled, they are generally fine.

"Reorganize the team and prepare to pursue!"

"These races that believe in alien gods are very threatening. We must eliminate them before they develop!"

"According to reliable intelligence, there is no powerful territory in this area. With our strength, we are enough to deal with it."

The priest was silent for a while and began to issue orders to reorganize the team to pursue.

Although the army lost a lot of troops, the impact on the overall combat power of the entire army was not as great as imagined.

The most important combat power of this army is the priest himself. With him, this army can still exert terrible combat power.

He is confident in his own strength.

On the other hand, Wu Qing is very satisfied with the resources provided by this group of bear goblins, which is enough to support him to fight such a fierce war of attrition.

In the Zerg territory, 40 puppies in batches are constantly rushing to the new preset battlefield position.

Wu Qing increased the number of hydralisks to 200.

The number of puppies is increasing rapidly and will soon return to 800.

As usual, 400 are in formation on the surface, and 400 are scattered everywhere and burrow into the ground to lurk.

The host retreated, still hovering far behind the battlefield to provide support.
